Date: 2028-04-02T18:10:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Apr 2 sandbox session — notes & owners

Elena / Sam — thanks everyone for the productive session today. Short recap and action items below. I kept the minutes intentionally tight — happy to expand on any point.

What we did
- Walked through 18 sample prompts (product + checkout flows).
- Validated routing rules for Product-A (70%) and Product-B (30%) with a canary policy to route 10% traffic initially.
- Ran a 10-minute burst load test (configured as agreed). Observed p50=38ms, p95=212ms for the requested prompt length; a few outliers correlated with cold KV cache misses.
- Identified two prompt patterns where response shape was inconsistent (examples in attached CSV).

Key decisions
- Canary policy: start at 10% for Product-A rising to 30% over 48 hours if no regressions.
- Add a short KV-cache warmup step in the pre-deploy job to eliminate cold-start outliers.
- Prompt normalization: RetailX will sanitize user-system splits for ~6 prompt templates and send back a cleaned set.

Action items (owner — due)
1) RetailX: Deliver sanitized prompt set (Elena) — due 2028-04-06
2) Redwood: Update canary policy template & automate ramp (Neha) — due 2028-04-05
3) Redwood: Add KV warmup to predeploy job + rerun burst test (Dev) — due 2028-04-04
4) RetailX: Confirm monitoring thresholds (Sam + Elena) — due 2028-04-07
5) Redwood + RetailX: Schedule follow-up longer load test (90m) — candidate dates listed below

Attachments: post-session-action-items.csv, loadtest-config.yaml (ran), Sandbox_Agenda_v1.pdf

Follow-up scheduling
- Candidate windows for the longer 90m load+validation run:
  * Wed Apr 9, 09:00–10:30 PT
  * Thu Apr 10, 13:00–14:30 PT
  * Tue Apr 15, 16:00–17:30 PT
Please confirm one slot and we will reserve Dedicated capacity for the run.

Next steps I will take
- Upload the action items CSV to the shared Drive and link it in HubSpot (done).
- Create a short canary runbook draft and share with Neha for review.

If this looks right I will mark items in the shared action sheet and follow up next week on progress.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
